headline: Marches, the November 20 parade and mass events will complicate mobility in CDMX
summary: Mexico's Sedatu agency said at a national congress that modernising land registry and cadastral systems can strengthen local governments' own revenues. The agency cited the importance of updated systems.
why: Property tax revenues depend on accurate cadastral records, which influence municipal and state fiscal capacity and the real estate tax base.
original_headline: Marchas, desfile del 20 de noviembre y eventos masivos complicarán la movilidad en la CDMX
